summary: Goldman Sachs Real Estate Finance Trust Inc filed an 8-K reporting the one-year renewal of its advisory agreement with Goldman Sachs Asset Management, L.P., effective June 10, 2026, on unchanged terms. It also disclosed an unregistered sale of 429,768.828 shares of common stock for ~$10.8M under its ongoing private offering, exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D, and announced monthly distributions for May 2026. These are routine operational updates; no special situation event such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring is present. Filing reflects regular business activity.
